Hi Alicia —

Quick one as we lock Q3 forecast: finance is asking us to confirm the committed ARR, product/SKU mapping, and the next-step in the pipeline for STEL-128 so we can bake it into the revenue plan. Can you confirm the following by EOD today (or send updated attachment):

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.
